title: GTA VI's day-one retail sales reached $3.79 billion worldwide, Take-Two Interactive said in a release dated 20 November 2026 (company estimate through end of day 19 November; Take-Two calls it a record for entertainment across any medium). Take-Two also says GTA VI sold 32.5 million units pre-release, a record across all platforms, and scored 99 on Metacritic. At ₹93.44 per dollar (rupee's 18 Nov close) that is over ₹35,000 crore (₹35,414 cr), about 2.6 times India's record 2025 box office gross of ₹13,395 crore (Ormax). The official count is above Sensor Tower's earlier $2.36 billion estimate. PlayStation Store India: Grand Theft Auto VI ₹5,999, Ultimate Edition ₹7,499; on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
headline: GTA VI: $3.79 Billion in Day-One Sales, Take-Two Says

image.subject: In-game GTA VI screenshot 'Vice_City_17': Vice City skyline at sunset (lit towers, palm trees), a police raid with police cars on a canal bridge, a Vice-Dale police boat and a lit yacht beside a waterfront villa and pool. Only small, distant in-game figures, none identifiable; no watermark or overlay lettering. Never used on an earlier idly cover (used so far: Vice_City_01/10/11/15/22/27, Leonida_Keys_01).

fact_sources.fact: GTA VI day-one retail sales reached $3.79 billion worldwide (company estimate through end of day 19 Nov); Take-Two release dated New York, 20 Nov 2026
Take-Two calls it a new record for entertainment across any medium / biggest entertainment launch in history
GTA VI sold 32.5 million units pre-release, a record across all platforms (Take-Two)

Rupee closed at 93.44 per US dollar on 18 Nov 2026 (latest close found; 20 Nov close not found). $3.79bn x 93.44 = ₹35,414 crore; 'over ₹35,000 crore' and '2.6x' hold for any rate from about 92.4 to 95.5
India's 2025 box office gross: ₹13,395 crore, a record (Ormax Box Office Report 2025); ₹35,414 / ₹13,395 = 2.64
Sensor Tower had estimated about $2.36 billion by end of launch day
PlayStation Store India: Grand Theft Auto VI Rs 5,999; Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition Rs 7,499 (store page re-opened 21 Nov 2026)
GTA VI is out on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S (Take-Two: available at PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store)
